The local Three.js r128 and matching OrbitControls distribution retain their
MIT license in THREE-LICENSE.txt. Compiled Tailwind CSS is generated from the
locked 3.4.17 development dependency; its MIT license is TAILWIND-LICENSE.txt.

manifest.json records upstream URLs and SHA-256 checksums. Run `npm run
check:assets` after packaging or updating a vendor file. The application does
not fetch any of these sources at runtime.
